verdict.rationale: Pipedream provides a well-documented official remote MCP server (mcp.pipedream.net / mcp.pipedream.com), with docs describing connecting any MCP client, per-app dedicated servers, managed auth, and framework integrations (Vercel AI SDK, Claude). This is a strong, first-party, extensively documented MCP server offering. missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party verification beyond vendor docs.
